✅ login 连续 Tab 焦点可见
✅ 加入弹窗 role=dialog + 焦点入内 — {"open":true,"label":"ok","activeIn":true}
✅ ESC 关闭弹窗 + 焦点不丢失 — {"dialogGone":true,"focusBack":true}
✅ 揭晓按钮焦点可见 — outline=solid 2px
✅ Enter 揭晓卡片 + 内容可见 — {"revealed":true,"bodyVisible":true}
✅ 铃铛 aria-expanded=true + 面板 aria-label — {"expanded":"true","panel":"通知面板"}
✅ ESC 关闭通知面板 — aria-expanded=false
✅ 弹窗聚焦元素数量 — {"ok":true,"count":3,"last":"加入"}
✅ Tab 从末尾循环回弹窗内
